question: Does the closed conditional current readout on two unknown changes in a known background survive a threefold grid mismatch? Can a calibrated measurement of the reference field remove all of this model error?
parents: same six archived SRAP family representatives as model_gap, no new parent objects
noise: 10 percent of differential signal, common unit noise vector for two grids; perfect reference calibration; known reference coarse material, at most two changed coarse cells
selection: MUSIC top-two versus same 12-cell shortlist and 4 candidate pairs as matching study. Fit starts at independently eliminated real-box conditional estimates; choose minimum measured residual. Audit the material by the full coarse Maxwell forward.
